title: SSO failover, KMS rotation evidence, and roles acceptance matrix
creator: Lindsey Park
description: Purpose: Define a tight acceptance matrix and evidence checklist for production-ready SSO (SAML/OIDC) federation, RBAC role mapping, audit log guarantees, and KMS/HSM key lifecycle for Private/VPC deployments. This document clarifies scope changes from the initial PRD, enumerates testable acceptance criteria, and lists required artifacts for customer sign-off and internal security review.
scope_included: SAML 2.0 IdP integration with attribute-to-role mapping
OIDC provider fallback for tenants that prefer modern flows
RBAC schema: operator, operator-readonly, tenant-admin, auditor
Audit log schema, retention (365d), integrity checks (tamper evidence)
KMS envelope encryption for model artifacts and secrets; HSM-backed root key management
Rotation plan for data keys and root keys including automated verification
Operational runbooks for emergency key rollback and tethered-operator scenarios
scope_excluded: Multi-tenant shared cloud key escrow service (future phase)
Customer-managed hardware HSM installation guidance (separate onboarding doc)
Third-party SIEM integrations beyond syslog/HTTP forwarding patterns
requirements: IdP federation: SAML ADFS/Okta/OneLogin tested; support for SHA256 signing and assertion encryption
Attribute map contract: 'email' -> principal.email, 'groups' -> principal.groups, 'role' -> principal.role
SSO failover: primary IdP outage detection and retry to secondary IdP within 30s; session continuity preserved for active sessions
RBAC enforcement: token introspection for every management-plane call; role escalation prevented via immutable role-assignments API
Audit logs: write-ahead append-only store; each record includes actor, resource, action, result, request_id, and a HMAC SHA256 chain per-day
Retention and export: 365 days retention in customer bucket; exports supporting signed CSV and JSONL with integrity checksum
KMS/HSM: root key stored only in HSM with attestations; data keys rotated every 90 days; rotation proofs published to audit logs
Rotation testing: automated rotation dry-run that verifies re-encryption of 100% active data keys without downtime for 99% of requests
Key compromise mode: emergency revoke + new root create workflow with documented customer notification timeline
Operational telemetry: dashboard showing 'last rotation', 'rotation success rate', 'IdP health (latency/5xx)', 'audit-write errors'
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end SAML integration: customer A (Okta) and customer B (ADFS) onboarded to private environment with successful login and correct role mapping
SSO failover test: simulate primary IdP outage and verify login flows failover to secondary within 30s and no dropped in-flight sessions for existing tokens
RBAC tests: role matrix tests that verify access denied for operator-readonly on write APIs and tenant-admin can create roles only within tenant scope
Audit integrity: injected tamper attempt detected by HMAC chain verification tool and logged as an alert; retention snapshot can be exported
KMS rotation test: automated rotation executed in staging, re-encryption completed, rotation proof entries exist in audit logs, and sample objects decrypt successfully with rotated keys
HSM attestation: vendor-signed attestation bundle present and validated by security team; HSM firmware version listed
Chaos validation: introduce 1% request drop during rotation window; system maintains SLA (p99 latency impact < 10%) and no data loss
Documentation: runbooks, SSO attribute map spec, RBAC role definitions, and rotation playbook uploaded to Confluence and linked in ticket
signoff_checklist: PRD clarifications incorporated and changes logged in changelog
Security review completed and signed by Security Engineering (ticket SEC-2119)
Legal/compliance acknowledgement for retention and export policies
Operational runbook reviewed by SRE and Oncall (oncall-playbook link)
Two customer pilots completed with distinct IdP vendors
HSM attestation and key custody proof validated (signed PDF stored)
End-to-end test artifacts: recordings, logs, and dashboards attached
Post-deploy monitoring alerts provisioned and tested (PagerDuty & Slack)
Executive sign-off from Product, Security, and Platform (names & dates below)
Rollback criteria and emergency contact list published
